## 1. Executive Summary
This sample is a malicious 64-bit Windows GUI PE executable masquerading as the legitimate open-source NSudo privilege escalation tool (version 6.2.1812.31) from M2-Team, with a verdict of Malicious (score: 75, family guess: Vidar) per cross-engine LLM and v1 judge agreement (source: llm_judge). Static and dynamic analysis confirm it is a packed, modified NSudo build with core capabilities consistent with the Vidar infostealer family: anti-debugging, privilege escalation, screenshot capture, Windows registry and token manipulation, persistence, and defense impairment. The binary exhibits a custom XOR unpacking stub, high-entropy obfuscated sections, and embedded network indicators consistent with command-and-control (C2) communication for data exfiltration. The sample filename suffix `_vidar` directly associates it with a Vidar campaign (source: sample_path filename). No official unmodified NSudo build includes screenshot functionality or the observed obfuscation, confirming malicious modification.
